audit: ExecWeave v0.8.3 system-wide provider/dashboard release audit

findings.title: Independent root sessions can be merged into one synthesized provider root conversation
findings.reproduction: Existing tests/test_conversation_identity_merge.py::test_two_same_provider_root_sessions_share_the_synthesized_root_thread constructs two different OpenCode session agents (ses_one and ses_two) and asserts one merged preview with thread_id opencode:root containing both ANSWER ONE and ANSWER TWO.
findings.expected: Independent provider sessions remain separate conversations unless positive provider evidence proves they are the same thread.
findings.actual: Root identity synthesis uses <provider>:root and /root scope, so independent roots can merge and their messages are unioned.
findings.root_cause: conversation_preview._agent_identity synthesizes provider:root for every root lacking a propagated provider-native thread; conversation merge keys then use the same provider, /root agent scope and synthesized thread.
findings.regression_needed: Invert the existing characterization: two independent provider session IDs must yield two conversation identities; add the same behavioral regression for at least one additional root-session provider.
evidence: Existing repository test deliberately asserts the merged behavior.
OpenCode session agents have distinct graph IDs agent:opencode:session:<sessionID>.
The conversation layer discards that distinction when synthesizing root thread identity.

findings.title: Local model runtime inference-request identity omits endpoint namespace
findings.reproduction: Call vllm_response_to_events (or another model_runtime adapter) twice with the same response/native request ID and two different endpoints. Runtime node IDs differ by endpoint digest, but both target inference-request:<runtime>:<native_id>.
findings.expected: A request observed from endpoint A and a request with the same native ID observed from endpoint B are distinct graph entities.
findings.actual: Both endpoints point to the same inference_request node and GraphAccumulator merges by entity ID.
findings.root_cause: model_runtime._runtime_entity hashes the endpoint, but _inference_entities constructs request ID without that endpoint digest.
findings.regression_needed: Behavioral identity test with two vLLM endpoints and the same native request ID; repeat for one ID-less runtime response.
evidence: Endpoint is part of runtime identity but absent from inference-request identity.

findings.title: Inference gateway request and deployment identities omit endpoint namespace
findings.reproduction: Call gateway_response_to_events/litellm_response_to_events with identical gateway/native request IDs against two independent proxy endpoints. Gateway node IDs differ, request node IDs do not. deployment IDs are likewise gateway-name scoped but not endpoint scoped.
findings.expected: Independent gateway instances are separate identity domains.
findings.actual: Same native request/deployment IDs collide across endpoints, producing false cross-gateway graph joins.
findings.root_cause: inference_gateway._gateway_entity hashes endpoint; inference_request and inference_deployment IDs omit endpoint digest.
findings.regression_needed: Two LiteLLM endpoint fixture with same response ID must produce distinct request nodes; generation lookup/reconciliation must still link only within the same endpoint scope.
evidence: Request ID format is inference-request:<gateway_name>:<native_id> while gateway ID includes endpoint digest.

findings.title: One OpenCode session materializes both generic and session-scoped agent identities
findings.reproduction: Feed one chat.message payload with sessionID to both the semantic adapter and full-fidelity path. Semantic USED_MODEL source is agent:OpenCode; conversation/content source is agent:opencode:session:<sessionID>. Full-fidelity metadata can also use the generic agent in the same processing cycle.
findings.expected: One logical provider session has exactly one graph agent identity.
findings.actual: The same session can create a generic root agent and a session-scoped root agent.
findings.root_cause: opencode_adapter._agent is always generic; opencode_full_fidelity._agent(payload) and agent_trace.opencode_session_agent are session scoped.
findings.regression_needed: One plugin payload should produce a single canonical agent ID across semantic, metadata, conversation and model edges.
evidence: The source ID formats are directly contradictory in current code.

findings.title: Antigravity Stop transcript archive fabricates provider-root provenance for every conversation
findings.reproduction: Archive any validated Antigravity Stop transcript. antigravity_conversation_archive_events creates agent:antigravity:conversation:<conversationId> and unconditionally expands root_topology(), whose default evidence is provider_session_root.
findings.expected: A conversation ID and transcript prove conversation identity/content, not that the conversation is a root. Root provenance must require positive root evidence; otherwise topology should remain derived/unresolved until parent evidence arrives.
findings.actual: The archive edge stamps provider-session-root evidence even for a conversation that can in fact be a child.
findings.root_cause: conversation_archive.antigravity_conversation_archive_events calls root_topology() without a provider fact establishing root status.
findings.regression_needed: A validated child-shaped Stop transcript must not acquire root_topology_evidence=provider_session_root solely from conversationId/transcriptPath.
evidence: The code path is unconditional after path validation; transcript validation validates location, not root status.

findings.title: Antigravity semantic tool evidence and conversation evidence use incompatible agent identity surfaces
findings.reproduction: For current PostToolUse payloads without toolCall identity, antigravity_adapter emits source agent:Antigravity while Stop archive evidence uses agent:antigravity:conversation:<conversationId>.
findings.expected: Tool/model/conversation observations for one provider conversation resolve to one logical agent unless there is positive evidence they represent different agents.
findings.actual: Two graph agent IDs remain distinct; graph merging is ID-based.
findings.root_cause: Fallback PostToolUse observation ignores its available conversationId when selecting source agent identity.
findings.regression_needed: PostToolUse and Stop fixtures sharing conversationId must resolve to the same graph agent identity, including a child conversation case.
evidence: PostToolUse already has conversationId in attributes and target ID but still uses generic source ID.

findings.title: Provider Capability Stage Integrity does not inventory all supported provider paths
findings.provider: Antigravity, OpenRouter, LiteLLM, Anthropic API, OpenAI-compatible and others
findings.reproduction: Compare provider_capability.REQUIRED_CAPABILITY_INVENTORY and docs/internal/provider-capability-matrix.md against adapters/gateways present in src/execweave. Several supported integration paths are absent from the release-stage inventory.
findings.expected: A workflow named Provider Capability Stage Integrity that gates every PR should either cover every supported provider path or explicitly state its narrower scope.
findings.actual: A green integrity check cannot detect capability regressions in several shipped integrations.
findings.root_cause: Capability inventory predates later adapters/gateways and was not expanded with the provider surface.
findings.regression_needed: Inventory consistency test generated from an explicit supported-provider registry, or an audited allowlist requiring every adapter/gateway to be classified.
evidence: Source integrations exist for Antigravity/OpenRouter/LiteLLM/Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible while required inventory omits them.

findings.title: Model catalog identity can merge unrelated providers solely by model string
findings.reproduction: Emit model observations from two unrelated provider/API paths using the same model string. anthropic.py, openai_compatible.py and inference_gateway.py create model:catalog:<model> without provider or endpoint namespace.
findings.expected: Unrelated providers are not canonicalized solely because a model label matches; a deliberate catalog equivalence requires positive evidence.
findings.actual: Identical strings produce the same graph model node.
findings.root_cause: Shared model-catalog ID treats provider-facing model label as globally authoritative identity.
findings.regression_needed: Same model string from two unrelated provider identities must stay distinct unless an explicit canonical catalog mapping establishes equivalence.
evidence: All affected helpers emit model:catalog:<raw model string>.

findings.title: ID-less inference fallback fingerprints are not occurrence identities
findings.provider: OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, gateways, local model runtimes
findings.reproduction: Call the same adapter twice with no explicit/native response ID and identical fields used by its fallback seed. Both calls deterministically receive the same inference request ID.
findings.expected: Repeated independent calls remain independent occurrences even when the provider does not publish a request ID.
findings.actual: The same response metadata fingerprint is reused and GraphAccumulator merges occurrences.
findings.root_cause: Fallback IDs hash response attributes rather than an observation occurrence/scope identity.
findings.regression_needed: Two ID-less identical responses recorded as separate observations must not collapse; linkage must be explicitly marked synthesized/non-provider-native.
evidence: Deterministic fallback seed omits an occurrence nonce/event sequence. Real collision frequency depends on provider fields.

findings.title: Real Antigravity historical turns may be lost or split after additional Stop events
findings.reproduction: User supplied a real run where prior turns disappeared, but this audit does not yet have a sanitized provider transcript fixture reproducing the loss on main.
findings.expected: All archived prior turns persist and older rounds fold rather than disappear.
findings.actual: Observed externally: earlier rounds disappeared in the real Antigravity run.
findings.root_cause: Not yet isolated; likely identity/topology split or transcript projection interaction. Do not assume causality until fixture reproduction.
findings.regression_needed: Sanitized 3-turn Antigravity transcript + repeated Stop fixture exercised through graph -> conversation records -> Chromium panel.
evidence: Real user observation; no independent sanitized fixture in repository yet.

known_limitations.title: Portable network polling can miss short-lived sockets
known_limitations.evidence: RuntimeCollector samples process network connections on a polling interval; connections that open and close between samples are unobservable.

known_limitations.title: Descendants that outlive the launched root are not continuously followed after root exit
known_limitations.evidence: RuntimeCollector loop terminates when the launched process exits; a still-live child is not emitted as exited and no subsequent samples are taken.

known_limitations.title: Gemini hook contract lacks a stable unique tool-call ID for exact before/after pairing
known_limitations.evidence: ExecWeave deliberately emits observation identity and does not assert exact direct linkage where the provider hook does not expose one.

known_limitations.title: Antigravity parent-child transcript correlation depends on a live-verified implementation wire
known_limitations.evidence: validated_subagent_links explicitly labels transcript record ordering as implementation wire and abstains on mismatch.

known_limitations.title: Conversation preview is UI-bounded to 80 messages
known_limitations.evidence: Conversation record merge keeps first 10 + last 70 preview messages when over 80; archived raw content remains available.

not_a_bug: Shipped static viewer is not a separate old renderer: viewer_projection.py uses dashboard_shell and the shared live dashboard shell.
Finished transition does not fetch /final or document.write the page on the audited emitted LIVE_HTML.
Conversation historical fold state does have real Chromium coverage for live polling, payload changes, explicit open/close and agent switching.
Cursor subagent support is not missing merely because cursor_adapter.py excludes those hooks; cursor_delegation_base.py handles documented subagentStart/subagentStop exactly.
Timestamp-prefix agent labels described by older failures are already guarded by tests/test_agent_node_labels.py.
